title: kurtosis

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider reduction hooks exist.

description: `kurtosis(X)` computes biased sample kurtosis, not excess kurtosis. `kurtosis(X,0,...)` applies the finite-sample bias correction. Dimension, vector-dimension, and `"all"` forms are supported.
behaviors: Flag `1` is the default biased moment estimator.
Flag `0` applies the usual finite-sample bias correction and returns `NaN` for slices with fewer than four values.
NaNs are treated as missing and omitted from each slice by default.

faqs.question: Does kurtosis return excess kurtosis?
faqs.answer: No. The returned value is kurtosis with the normal distribution centered around 3.
